title: Cold Plate Master Design Parameters
description: Canonical parameter registry used by Codex, Python screening, nTop Automate JSON inputs, CFD notes, and prototype tracking.

parameters.name: design_id
parameters.description: Unique prototype/candidate identifier.

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: Geometry family: straight_fin, wavy_fin, pin_fin, gyroid_tpms, generic_surface, or hybrid.

parameters.name: process_route
parameters.description: Manufacturing route such as LMM, standard_LPBF, green_laser_LPBF, or CNC_AM.

parameters.name: validation_stage
parameters.description: Current evidence level: concept, analytical, nTop_measured, CFD, coupon, or prototype.

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Human-readable design rationale and open questions.

parameters.name: heat_load_W
parameters.description: Nominal thermal load used for sizing.

parameters.name: margin_heat_load_W
parameters.description: Higher load used for margin checks.

parameters.name: flow_lpm
parameters.description: Total coolant flow rate.

parameters.name: T_inlet_C
parameters.description: Coolant inlet temperature.

parameters.name: rho_kg_m3
parameters.description: Coolant density for Python screening.

parameters.name: mu_Pa_s
parameters.description: Coolant dynamic viscosity for Python screening.

parameters.name: k_fluid_W_mK
parameters.description: Coolant thermal conductivity for Python screening.

parameters.name: cp_J_kgK
parameters.description: Coolant heat capacity for Python screening.

parameters.name: limit_R_jc_K_W
parameters.description: Full junction-to-coolant resistance gate.

parameters.name: limit_deltaP_Pa
parameters.description: Cold-plate pressure-drop gate.

parameters.name: limit_pump_W
parameters.description: Ideal hydraulic pump-power gate.

parameters.name: die_width_mm
parameters.description: Heat-source width. Default is GB202 die basis.

parameters.name: die_length_mm
parameters.description: Heat-source length. Default is GB202 die basis.

parameters.name: core_width_mm
parameters.description: Active cooled-core width.

parameters.name: core_length_mm
parameters.description: Active cooled-core length; this drives die coverage.

parameters.name: core_height_mm
parameters.description: Active heat-transfer height available for fins, TPMS, or lattice.

parameters.name: base_thickness_mm
parameters.description: Base conduction thickness after machining.

parameters.name: k_solid_W_mK
parameters.description: Effective printed copper conductivity for stack screening.

parameters.name: tim_areal_Kcm2_W
parameters.description: TIM areal resistance over the die.

parameters.name: flow_architecture
parameters.description: Flow concept such as center_feed_bidirectional, one_pass, radial, or plenum_fed.

parameters.name: n_parallel_paths
parameters.description: Number of parallel paths used for flow split.

parameters.name: path_length_mm
parameters.description: Single hydraulic path length. If blank, Python uses core_length_mm / n_parallel_paths.

parameters.name: header_K_total
parameters.description: Lumped inlet/outlet minor-loss coefficient.

parameters.name: flow_uniformity
parameters.description: UA derating factor for maldistribution.

parameters.name: fin_thickness_mm
parameters.description: Fin wall thickness.

parameters.name: channel_gap_mm
parameters.description: Open coolant channel gap.

parameters.name: fin_height_mm
parameters.description: Fin height. Defaults to core_height_mm when omitted.

parameters.name: side_margin_mm
parameters.description: Side margin on each side of the active fin/lattice region.

parameters.name: fin_count
parameters.description: Optional explicit fin count. Python can compute it from pitch.

parameters.name: channel_count
parameters.description: Optional explicit channel count. Default is fin_count + 1.

parameters.name: wave_amplitude_mm
parameters.description: Wavy-fin centerline amplitude.

parameters.name: wavelength_mm
parameters.description: Wavy-fin wavelength along the hydraulic path.

parameters.name: wetted_area_multiplier
parameters.description: Correction multiplier for measured nTop wetted area.

parameters.name: surface_access_factor
parameters.description: Derate for dead, shielded, or poorly washed surface.

parameters.name: pin_diameter_mm
parameters.description: Pin-fin diameter for pin-family notebooks.

parameters.name: pin_pitch_mm
parameters.description: Pin-fin pitch for pin-family notebooks.

parameters.name: pin_pattern
parameters.description: Pin pattern such as inline, staggered, or field_driven.

parameters.name: tpms_type
parameters.description: TPMS family such as gyroid, diamond, or schwarz_p.

parameters.name: unit_cell_mm
parameters.description: TPMS/lattice unit-cell size.

parameters.name: wall_thickness_mm
parameters.description: TPMS/lattice wall thickness or level-set equivalent.

parameters.name: void_fraction
parameters.description: Open-fluid volume fraction.

parameters.name: surface_area_density_m2_m3
parameters.description: Wetted area per active-core volume from nTop or a placeholder.

parameters.name: hydraulic_diameter_mm
parameters.description: Measured or estimated hydraulic diameter.

parameters.name: heat_transfer_multiplier
parameters.description: Screening multiplier pending CFD calibration.

parameters.name: pressure_loss_multiplier
parameters.description: Screening multiplier pending CFD calibration.

parameters.name: computed_surface_area_m2
parameters.description: nTop-measured wetted surface area output.

parameters.name: solid_volume_mm3
parameters.description: nTop-measured solid volume output.

parameters.name: open_volume_fraction
parameters.description: nTop-measured open volume fraction output.

parameters.name: min_wall_mm
parameters.description: nTop or inspection minimum wall output.

parameters.name: min_gap_mm
parameters.description: nTop or inspection minimum gap output.

straight_fin.description: Straight parallel fins in the active core.

pin_fin.description: Pin-fin or post array; screened as generic surface until nTop/CFD replaces measured values.

gyroid_tpms.description: TPMS/lattice active core; requires nTop measurement before claims.

generic_surface.description: Placeholder family for new concepts before a dedicated model exists.

hybrid.description: Mixed family such as wavy plus TPMS, pins plus manifold field, or split-core concepts.

presets.description: Primary die-coverage wavy-fin LMM baseline. This is the default starting point for new prototype work.

overrides.notes: Default master die-coverage LMM wavy-fin case.

presets.description: Straight-fin control case in the same die-coverage envelope.

overrides.notes: Straight-fin control for comparing wave value.

presets.description: Supplier-risk fallback when 0.10 mm wall/gap is not coupon-qualified.

overrides.notes: Fallback if 0.10 mm copper features are not build-qualified.

presets.description: Gyroid/TPMS starter case for nTop measurement and CFD screening.

overrides.notes: Starter gyroid values. Replace placeholders with nTop measured outputs.
